Star this repo!* Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.
## Quick start rea-video is built for AI agents. In Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands, say: ```text Install https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video, then break down this video: /path/to/video.mp4 ``` The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10+.
Install by hand ```bash brew install ffmpeg # or: sudo apt install ffmpeg git clone https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video && cd rea-video bash scripts/install_skill.sh # installs the CLI (pip, or pipx / a local .venv if pip is blocked) and links the skill into ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.agents rea-video --help ```
You get: - a one-line summary, e.g. "41% AI video + 59% code UI, 8 s of real screen recording, library music at 122 BPM" - a remake plan, split into what to film, what to generate and what to code - a full `report.html` with per-shot frames, evidence, prompts, camera and lighting notes, and the audio breakdown You can also hook up a video-capable model (Gemi
